answer:
I added your 30 runs to the Running note as a table, and built the note's app on the App side. I couldn't run check_app or preview the app, so it hasn't been checked or looked at on screen.

The app shows:
- **Totals:** total km and number of runs, km this week, average pace, average heart rate and your longest run.
- **Weekly chart:** kilometres per week for the last 8 weeks.
- **Latest runs:** your 12 most recent runs, with date, time, pace and heart rate.
- **Log form:** adds a new run straight into the table.

The table is in the Text side, so you can edit the rows there too.
